annotations.title: Prepare a French legal notice on legalone.fr

description: Use this when the user wants LegalOne to prepare their legal notice for an existing company (registered office transfer, change of manager or president, name, corporate purpose, share capital, duration, early dissolution, liquidation closure): creates a draft on legalone.fr from the SIREN and the facts the user gave, and returns the notice text, what is left to complete and a link, valid 7 days, that opens the pre-filled form. The user reviews, completes and pays on legalone.fr; nothing is published or paid here. Do not use for a company creation, and do not send home addresses, birth dates or contact details: they are completed on legalone.fr.

companyDurationYears.description: Company duration in years, as in the articles of association.

decisionDate.description: Date of the meeting or decision (YYYY-MM-DD).

department.description: Publication department, used only when it cannot be read from the company's registered office (the notice is published where the office is).

newCapital.description: Share capital after the operation, in euros.

newPurpose.description: Corporate purpose as written in the decision.

newSeatCourt.description: Commercial court (greffe) of the new registered office, e.g. Nanterre; deduced when the department has one court.

newSeatStreet.description: New registered office: number and street.

officerChange.description: appointment: a new officer without departure; replacement: one leaves, one arrives; departure: one leaves without replacement.

representativeRole.description: Role of the legal representative named in the arrival notice.

siren.description: SIREN of the company (9 digits, spaces allowed).
